page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6a.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 AMD EPYC 7H12 processor running at 2.6 GHz, with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates average multi-core performance but highlights specific single-core and memory constraints. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance falls into the bottom 10%, though multi-core CPU performance and Geekbench multi-core scores align with the middle 50% average. Memory bandwidth benchmarks reveal a significant performance gap: while cached small-block reads achieve average speeds of 802.27 GB/sec, uncached large-block reads and writes are weak, placing in the bottom 25% at 30.52 GB/sec and 15.5 GB/sec respectively.

Given the balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance represents a standard general-purpose hardware profile. It is suitable for workloads such as static web serving, database operations, and multi-threaded decompression, where it demonstrates average benchmark throughput. However, the poor single-core performance and weak uncached memory bandwidth make it less suitable for memory-intensive sequential processing or single-threaded compute tasks.
